regions.name: Solimões
regions.quote: Records thus exist from the Solimões, Purus, Japurá, Caquetá, Yavarí, Tefé, Napo and Ucayali drainage basins although it's worth noting that a number of similar-looking fishes also exist in the region, and only some of them are described to science (see 'Notes').
